segments.text: Ted DiBiase takes on Johnny Rodz in singles action. Chief Jay Strongbow returns to battle Moose Monroe. Plus, a huge Tag Team Match!
Things take an unexpected turn when Jimmy Valiant readies to battle Dominic DeNucci. Plus, Ted DiBiase, The Great Hussein Arab, and more!
